video_title: Tristan Jass on Surviving Brain Surgery, Pro Hoops & MrBeast | Thanalysis Show

quotes.speaker: Tristan Jass
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Jass on his 2019 brain surgery and recovery
quotes.excerpt: I had a seizure. My brain shut down because I wasn't taking care of myself.
quotes.quote: 2019, I woke up in the hospital. I had a seizure. This was around the time when things started blowing up for me on social media, and money starts rolling in. I'm like, oh my gosh, I can make money off filming basketball videos? This is crazy. So I was just going non-stop every day, up all night editing videos, was forgetting to stay hydrated, wasn't eating food, just going so hard and I wasn't taking care of my body. I was going so hard that I had a seizure. Literally, my brain shut down because I wasn't taking care of myself.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Jass
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Jass on the discovery of a brain cyst
quotes.excerpt: In this last MRI that I got, they were like, there's a small dot in the center.
quotes.quote: Since 2019, I've been getting my yearly MRIs. They put you in this tube, and it's crazy. It grew a little bit over the years, nothing too crazy. In this last MRI that I got, they were like, there's a small dot in the center. This could be signs that it could be turning into something that we don't want it to turn into. We think we should go in there and remove it. I just remember sitting there, listening to my doctor say that, like, brain surgery? I've never had any type of surgery. I've never been put under for anything, and my first surgery is going to be brain surgery.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Jass
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Jass on the mental toll of brain surgery recovery
quotes.excerpt: The mental side, I wasn't expecting it to hit me like that.
quotes.quote: The mental side, I wasn't expecting it to hit me like that. I'll be honest with you guys, the first 30 days after you have a brain surgery, they mandatory have you on anti-seizure medication. This medication was messing me up, having anxiety. I was feeling out of it. And then coming off of the medication, you feel even more weird because you're like, what's going on? My body is going all over the place. It was a lot of anxiety and it was a big mental battle.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the value of creating your own tribe
quotes.excerpt: This is why I say this all the time, create your tribe.
quotes.quote: This is why I say this all the time, create your tribe. My guys, invest in them. Literally say, hey, what do you want to do? I want to open a store, I want to do this, cool. You want to do this, cool. Because what you want to do is, hopefully, you build this so that your tide, that this will all come back to you. Not money-wise, but in terms of lifestyle.
